scope: Every ordinary body-flow citation claim in manuscript/main.tex and every canonical entry in manuscript/references.bib; primary-record metadata, exact supporting passages, user-library relevance, bibliography coverage, AUX/BibTeX consistency, and compilation diagnostics were checked.
citation_audit_method: Two-stage non-interactive citation-check audit: freeze each substantive claim/citation pair in a digest-bound ledger, then independently replay exact primary-source locators and classify support; follow with a canonical BibTeX and build-log consistency audit.
